syllabus.publisher: 中外语言交流合作中心 / Center for Language Education and Cooperation
syllabus.extraction: Factual table fields only. Large watermark characters excluded; homograph sense numbers retained. No explanatory prose, tasks, or sample exam questions copied.

dictionary.title: CC-CEDICT
dictionary.creator: CC-CEDICT contributors
dictionary.changes: Selected pronunciations for the official syllabus; treated neutral-tone dictionary variants as closer than conflicting lexical tones; preferred ordinary forms over proper names, rare variants and reference-only forms; omitted surname/variant-only entries, classifier annotations, and cross-reference pinyin; converted entries into JSON. Editorial sense corrections are maintained separately.

examples.title: Tatoeba sentence collection
examples.creator: Tatoeba contributors; individual authors and sentence IDs recorded on each example
examples.selection: Direct translation links; self-declared native Chinese and English contributors (and Korean when present); exact target token and lexical pronunciation; ambiguous homographs excluded for separate editorial treatment.
examples.review: Corpus-selected examples, not a claim of professional editorial review. Automatically generated sentence pinyin requires a final spoken-language check before commercial release.

editorial.title: learn_chinese editorial corrections
editorial.description: Original teaching glosses and examples, plus editorial translations and corrections. Tatoeba adaptations retain original author IDs and licenses on each sentence. Sense numbers follow the official syllabus. AI-assisted content.
